answer: A reputation kernel that starts at zero and only grows through work attested by independent peers resists Sybils: standing cannot be bought, transferred, or copied, it must be earned. Like bees gathering nectar flower by flower before reaching the summit, each identity must deliver real services over many epochs before its votes carry weight. Spinning up a thousand fresh identities yields a thousand zero-weight accounts; faking history means doing real work a thousand times over, at real time and compute cost, and reputation decays without continued honest service.
